verdict.rationale: Shortcut's own pricing and home pages list native GitHub and Slack integrations, plus GitLab, Bitbucket and Figma, but nothing in the pack mentions Google Drive. The evidence is also only brief marketing lines. Missing for 10: a native Google Drive integration, in-depth integration docs (setup, scope, sync behavior), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can connect common tools like Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive natively

citations.quote: Seamless integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and other tools mean Shortcut updates while you work.
Avoid merge conflicts and duplicative code when using the GitHub integration
